WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT 
    f.feerate,
    f.rebrate,
    COALESCE(o.mktnote, '') AS pair_group
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
pair_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    pair_group,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_rate
  FROM matched_fees
  WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL AND rebrate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pair_group
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS overall_avg
  FROM matched_fees
  WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL AND rebrate IS NOT NULL
),
above_avg_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.avg_net_rate,
    pa.avg_net_rate - oa.overall_avg AS excess
  FROM pair_avgs pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND pa.avg_net_rate > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_net_rate) AS mean_of_avg_net_fee_rates,
  AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_overall
FROM above_avg_pairs
